styles.label: Shop style
styles.disclaimer: Styles are source-backed editorial judgements, not popularity rankings or claims by the shop.
styles.reviewHelp: Styles may overlap. Approving a label does not publish a shop; shop and location checks still apply. Pending and rejected labels remain private.
styles.instagrammableCriteria: Official sources must show this branch’s distinctive spatial design, displays or visual features; not traffic, gender or portraits.
styles.artsyCriteria: Require specific books, art, design, music, curated goods or local culture; coffee alone is not enough.
styles.saved: Style review saved; shop publication status is unchanged.
styles.createFirst: Save the shop first, then add and review its styles.

title: Verified food merchants, city by city
description: Every merchant is checked against official sources. Browse by city, area, and cuisine, and meet each country's signature dishes.
chooseCityTitle: Pick a city to narrow this down
chooseCityBody: You do not have to: every city's merchants are already listed below. The number after each city is how many have been verified.
emptyFiltersBody: Clear the area or cuisine filter, or try another keyword.
emptyCityTitle: Merchants in {city} are still being verified
emptyCityBody: No merchant here has passed official-source verification yet. Start with the signature dishes.
merchantNotice: Merchant names come from a reviewed catalog. Confirm current hours and branches on the Google Maps page, or the Naver Map page in Korea.
activeFiltersHint: Filters in use — tap one to remove it
